headline: D. B. Cooper jumps into history
post_facts: He jumped from the rear stairs of a Boeing 727

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen seventy-one... a hijacker jumped from a jet with the ransom... and vanished.

scenes.label: FBI composite sketch
scenes.caption: The man known as D. B. Cooper
scenes.title: A passenger named Dan Cooper
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] He flew as Dan Cooper, from Portland to Seattle.

scenes.label: ransom in cash, plus four parachutes
scenes.text: [calmly] He demanded two hundred thousand dollars and four parachutes.

scenes.label: A Northwest Orient Boeing 727
scenes.caption: The same type of jet, 1970
scenes.title: A jump into the night
scenes.text: [softly] He freed the passengers in Seattle, then jumped from the rear stairs into the night.

scenes.title: Never identified
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Only a little of the money was ever found. He was never identified.

scenes.title: What happened to D. B. Cooper?
scenes.text: [gently] What do you think happened to him?
[warmly] Follow On This Day USA... for a new story from history, every day.
